title: Claims Settlement Worksheet: Finish Settlement Amount, Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
**Computation.** On a Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage, the scheduled finish settlement is the program's cash-in-lieu maximum multiplied by the settlement share of 0.45, the product rounded to the nearest cent. The finish settlement is the scheduled finish settlement, and the finish settlement never exceeds the program's cash-in-lieu maximum, that comparison being made on the finish settlement itself.

The cash-in-lieu maximum is the figure of the home's HomeCare program in its schedule of cash settlement limits.

## Worksheet lines

| Line | Entry |
|---|---|
| A | The program's cash-in-lieu maximum |
| B | Settlement share: 0.45 |
| C | Scheduled finish settlement: line A multiplied by line B, rounded to the nearest cent |
| D | Finish settlement: line C, never more than line A |

## Worked figures (hypothetical maxima)

| Program cash-in-lieu maximum | A multiplied by 0.45 | Scheduled finish settlement | Finish settlement |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 750.00 | 337.50 | USD 337.50 | USD 337.50 |
| USD 1000.00 | 450.00 | USD 450.00 | USD 450.00 |
| USD 1500.00 | 675.00 | USD 675.00 | USD 675.00 |

**Point of reading.** Rounding happens once, on the product that forms the scheduled finish settlement; the comparison with the cash-in-lieu maximum is made on the finished figure.
